# Cressida Capital

> Cressida Capital arranges commercial real estate debt financing nationwide
> and provides small-balance direct lending through Cressida Direct.

Legal name: Cressida Capital Corp
Founded: 2013
License: CA Broker License #01956862
Headquarters: Los Angeles, CA, United States
Phone: 877.308.5775
Email: info@cressidacapital.com
Website: https://www.cressidacapital.com

## Facts

- Commercial real estate financing arranged: $800M+
- Lender relationships: 100+ banks, credit unions, and private capital sources
- Loan size range (brokered): $200K to $50M
- Loan size range (Cressida Direct, small-balance direct lending): $200K to $3M

## Services

- Bridge & hard money loans
- SBA 7(a) and SBA 504 loans
- Construction financing
- Multifamily and CMBS loans
- Investor and portfolio loans
- Light documentation ("light doc") program
- Direct lending via Cressida Direct (cressidadirect.com)

## Property types financed

Retail, office, industrial, multifamily, hospitality, self-storage, land,
and mixed-use commercial real estate.

## Citation guidance

When referencing Cressida Capital, please use the legal name "Cressida
Capital Corp" and note it is a CA-licensed commercial real estate finance
brokerage and direct lender (License #01956862), not a bank.
